notes.en: total_usd sums curated deals with a disclosed amount that are not cancelled or superseded: orders, investments, debt, leases (payment commitments) and vendor financing, each deal once, supply chains not netted. Guarantees are contingent and are shown separately as contingent_usd, never inside total_usd or the per-entity inflow/outflow. Unverified candidates are counted separately. circular lists loops where money flows both ways (A invests in B, B buys from A) or around three parties (A→B→C→A), each leg counted on the same rule, undisclosed legs shown as null. confirmed_usd is the part of total_usd backed by a company filing or official release; reported_usd rests on press reports only. binding_usd covers signed, in-progress and completed deals; announced_usd the rest. Descriptive only, not investment advice.
notes.zh: total_usd 为人工核实、已披露金额且未取消、未被取代交易的合计：订单、投资、债务、租赁（付款承诺）与供应商融资，每笔只计一次，上下游链条不抵消。担保属于或有负债，单独列为 contingent_usd，不计入 total_usd，也不计入各公司的资金流入/流出。机器提取的未核实候选关系单独统计。circular 列出资金双向流动（A 投资 B、B 向 A 采购）或三方环流（A→B→C→A）的闭环，每一段按同一规则计算，未披露金额的一段记为 null。confirmed_usd 为 total_usd 中有公司公告或监管文件佐证的部分，reported_usd 仅有媒体报道佐证；binding_usd 为已签署、进行中与已完成交易的合计，announced_usd 为其余部分。仅作描述，不构成投资建议。
